invariants.rationale: The method accesses layer for method calls; null would likely cause a NullPointerException.
If getTextureRegion() is non-null, it is used for drawing later and must have a valid texture.
X coordinate is typically non-negative for visible map layers.
Y coordinate is typically non-negative for visible map layers.
Parallax factors are usually non-negative (>= 0) in graphics/tiled map code.
